claim: Around 40g protein and at least 15g fibre per serving.
fibre_bound_note: Mozzarella and passata list fibre as '<0.5g per 100g'. Upper bound counts those as 0.5g; lower bound as 0g. 16.94g is the upper-bound sum, 15.69g the lower bound.
protein_exactness_note: Protein column has no '<' values; 40.025g is the exact sum of the four verified per-100g figures at the chosen grams.
basis_notes: Beans and mozzarella use per-100g drained figures; no raw/dry bean weight is used.
One 400g can of Sainsbury's cannellini beans declares 235g drained weight, so 235g drained is one can and avoids opening a second.
Passata and baby spinach are used as sold, which is the only basis their tables give.

cooking_instructions.status: suggested method only - not physically cooked or timed as part of this task
steps: Drain and rinse one 400g can of cannellini beans; about 235g beans.
Warm 150g passata in a pan, add the beans and 50g baby spinach, stir until the spinach wilts.
Tear or grate 100g lighter mozzarella over the top, cover briefly or grill until melted.
Season to taste and serve as one portion.
cooking_instructions.time_note: No measured cooking time is claimed. Retailer pack/can guidance is the only time reference; the method is a reasonable suggestion, untested here.
